description: Source code for handling interrupts and triggers for the LIS2MDL 3-axis magnetometer sensor in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: lis2mdl_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the interrupt on the LIS2MDL sensor.

methods.name: lis2mdl_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the trigger for data ready events and sets the handler.

methods.name: lis2mdl_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, calls the registered handler, and manages semaphore.

methods.name: lis2mdl_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, disables GPIO interrupt and signals thread.

methods.name: lis2mdl_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread mode.

methods.name: lis2mdl_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for handling interrupts in global thread mode.

methods.name: lis2mdl_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the LIS2MDL sensor.
